# PiTTy 0.6.49

## Symlinked agent profiles resolve correctly

- PiTTy now follows symlinked agent profiles when reading their frontmatter, mirroring the extension itself. Previously it missed the pin, so e.g. `impl-check-*` showed the shared-defaults model while actually running the `profile`-pinned one.
- That mismatch is why changing a model looked ignored: a profile pin beats shared defaults by design. The rows now show the true source, and setting a model or thinking level on that agent writes a per-agent override, which does win (verified against the extension's resolver).
- All ten profiles resolve and are listed.

Run `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.49` to stage the release. It activates on your next PiTTy launch.
